prompt:
The section sections/store-events-calendar.liquid renders a list of store events. Its markup marks the first rendered event with the class events-calendar__item--first and the last one with events-calendar__item--last. It shows at most section.settings.max_events events. The schema is incomplete: the max_events setting it relies on does not exist, there is no block limit, and the preset adds no events, so the first/last styling cannot be previewed. Do not change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %} block so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array items in this order:
- "name": "Events calendar"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-events-calendar"
- "settings", in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Upcoming events"
  2. type "range", id "max_events", label "Maximum events shown", min 1, max 12, step 1, default 6. All four are JSON numbers.
- "blocks": one block type, with type "event" and name "Event". Its settings, in this order:
  1. type "text", id "title", label "Event title", default "Store event"
  2. type "text", id "date", label "Date", default "January 1"
- "max_blocks": 12 (a number)
- "presets": one preset with name "Events calendar" and blocks set to exactly three entries, each {"type": "event"}. Three events let the merchant see a first, a middle and a last item.
Add no other keys. Change only sections/store-events-calendar.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
